invariants.rule: Execution toolbox only; no biological experiment, final learner, full compiler/JIT, distributed engine or sequence inference is implicitly activated.
GlassHelix owns scientific roles/composition/interpretation; Cellerator owns reusable numerical and execution machinery. Improve current owners instead of duplicating engines.
Domain/order/structure/epoch/value identity is explicit. Scientific mechanism identity is not a kernel boundary; stable ids do not establish biological identifiability.
Dynamical state, observations and inferential state are distinct. Missing values and zeros differ. Population snapshots are not fabricated individual trajectories.
Mechanisms admit true n-ary nonlinear dependence and role-ordered arguments; pairwise execution specializations do not constrain scientific ontology.
Independent mutable bindings over shared structure; complete preflight; readiness differs from submission; stale and poisoned state cannot publish valid results.
Derivative capabilities are optional and explicit. Missing derivative is not zero. Preserve primal generations and distinct primal/parameter-response support.
Real f32 path and independent f64 oracle; qualify precision, pruning, fusion and error. Local null diagnostics are not global identifiability claims.
No mock, syntax-only program, skipped/missing test, header declaration or CPU fallback satisfies real native/GPU acceptance.

After controller launch, complete the accepted program autonomously using first-class project-qualified claims; revise scopes/contracts through authority when necessary, without repeated ordinary-choice confirmation.
Preserve unrelated dirty work, branches, runs, pending patches and consumers. No reset/clean/force rewrite or CE-AMP activation. Clean only owned verified-merged worktrees.
Two independent additive schema-3 imports. Never write SQLite/generated authority directly. Import may create active run metadata but never dispatches through package scripts.
Cross-project work is gated by source/interface/test receipts and fresh authoritative producer completion. No fictitious foreign native dependency or cross-project parent lane.
Whole-lifetime cost governs promotion. Preserve correct alternatives and negative results. One real GPU lease plus shared host lock across both authorities.

charter.objective: GlassHelix native execution and interrogation foundation; execute the approved toolbox program autonomously after user controller launch, not during manual import.
boundaries: One GlassHelix strategic controller coordinates both independent authorities; every substantial worker is first class.
Read the paired scope and autonomy charter. Adjust scopes/interfaces through authority, preserve work, integrate and push incrementally.
No biological experiment, full learning model, CellShard program, broad compiler or old CE-AMP activation.
Import may create active run metadata but no worker dispatch; later user launch authorizes the whole accepted program.
